# BarakahFlow

> Mindful personal finance for Muslims. Spending, bills, budgets, savings and a Barakah Card that grows with thoughtful financial check-ins.

- Website: https://barakahflowapp.com/
- Web app: https://app.barakahflowapp.com/
- Android APK: https://barakahflowapp.com/downloads/barakahflow.apk
- Privacy: https://barakahflowapp.com/privacy-policy.html
- Terms: https://barakahflowapp.com/terms.html
- Account deletion: https://barakahflowapp.com/delete-account
- Contact: barakahflowapp@gmail.com

## Current capabilities

- Summary dashboard with a cash-balance Barakah Card, account balances, budget progress, upcoming bills and savings.
- Manual income and expense records; Quick Spend; searchable transaction history.
- Category budgets and a configurable financial month.
- Recurring bills with payment records and advancing due dates.
- Savings goals with targets, contributions, withdrawals and optional account links.
- Accounts in their own currencies with display-currency totals.
- Personalised setup, guided financial check-ins, light/dark themes and balance visibility.

## Barakah Cards

These are in-app visual designs, not bank accounts, payment cards, credit products or financial rewards.
Essential is the starting edition. Emerald requires one accepted first check-in.
Midnight Gold requires three accepted weekly check-ins after the first check-in.
Pearl Platinum requires eight accepted weekly check-ins in total plus two complete financial-period reviews.
Weekly checks are at least seven days apart. There is no streak requirement; earned editions remain available.
The in-app card displays cash balance, not total net worth. The website's dashboard balance is illustrative; standalone card art omits balances.
An optional Essential writing preview demonstrates the Arabic word. Full earned-card reveals remain in the app.

## Availability and limits

Free to use with no subscription and no ads. Available in a web browser and as an Android APK.
iPhone users can open the web app in Safari and add it to the Home Screen; no App Store listing is advertised.
Accounts and transactions are entered manually; automatic bank imports are not advertised.
Private experiments, planned features and prototype card artwork are not public product capabilities.
